defects.description: A green fringe remains around the outer cat ears, headband-adjacent boundary and side hair loops. It is visible after actual Alpha compositing onto a dark background, not merely hidden RGB under zero Alpha. The standard green-alpha intersection reduces part of the outer halo but does not remove this visual defect.

On the blue background, most of the former white-filled hair gap becomes blue, but a narrow pale gray/white and green edge remains along the right side hair loop. This is described as an edge fringe, not a newly proven solid white island or an anatomical part to erase.

observed_improvement: The large white/gray source backdrop, green floor oval and most enclosed background areas are removed in the inspected samples; the white headband and visible face are not wholly deleted. This partial improvement is not sufficient for release.

inspection_scope.why_visual_scan_stopped: An edge hard defect was already confirmed at original output resolution and enlarged native crops. The owner requested stopping redundant comprehensive review of rejected variants.

followup: Later bounded or physical-matting sample experiments are distinct candidates and do not overwrite this SHA-bound rejection. Any future complete output needs its own independent review.

actual_playback_evidence.reason: The residual edge defect was confirmed before playback, so the rejected variant did not receive a redundant full playback run.
